name: Dara Okonkwo
notes: True two-column layout: skills, education, certifications, and awards in right sidebar; career summary and experience in main left column. Multiple locations across experience sections (Denver, Boulder, Fort Collins).

sections.heading: CAREER SUMMARY
items: Environmental scientist turned project manager with 8+ years delivering field research, remediation, and sustainability initiatives. Experienced leading cross-functional teams on federal and municipal contracts, with a strong record of keeping complex multi-site projects on scope and on budget.

items.title: Senior Project Manager, Greenfield Environmental Consulting
items.subtitle: Denver, CO
bullets: Managed 6 concurrent remediation projects across 3 states with a combined budget of $4.8M, delivering all on schedule.
Led stakeholder engagement with EPA, state agencies, and local community groups to obtain environmental permits.
Introduced Agile sprint cycles for internal reporting, reducing documentation turnaround by 40%.

items.title: Environmental Project Manager, Summit Earth Solutions
items.subtitle: Boulder, CO
bullets: Oversaw Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments for 20+ commercial and industrial properties.
Coordinated field teams of up to 10 scientists across multi-month sampling campaigns.
Authored technical reports and presented findings to municipal clients and regulatory bodies.

items.title: Environmental Scientist, Rocky Mountain Research Institute
items.subtitle: Fort Collins, CO
bullets: Conducted water quality monitoring and soil sampling across 15 watershed sites.
Contributed to federally funded NEPA compliance reports for land-use planning projects.
Maintained field data collection protocols and QA/QC procedures.

sections.heading: AWARDS
items: Summit Earth Solutions Employee of the Year, 2019
